purpose: ARM B deployment build. P0-B (public 0.914) with exactly one semantic edit: motion_relink_edges gates candidate eligibility on the kNN16 flow-compensated residual |target - (source + flow(source))| instead of the raw source-target distance |target - source|. SAME 6.0/10.0 um radius, SAME cost expression, SAME detector, weights, ILP config, division logic, pruning and submission format.

provenance.evidence: P0-strict LOEO, complete wrapper, 144/144 crops parity-exact: pooled +0.0079822, 44b6 +0.0167567, 6bba +0.0067055, P(delta>0)=1.000 on all three, min-fold clears +0.005. E0c 199/199: +0.0088059 pooled.
provenance.caveat: arm B admits slightly MORE pairs at the tight radius (+0.169% E0c, +0.388% P0-strict). It is a re-aim with small net widening, NOT monotone widening: B is not a superset of A (7.2% churn). Branch A's global-widening failure (-0.1596/-0.1496) is therefore not live, but the arm must never be described as 'admits fewer'.
